content.text: You’ve tried the platforms. They failed you. Stripe rejects your country. PayPal locks your account. Gumroad holds your funds. You need a store that runs on infrastructure you own—not rent. Cloudflare Pages hosts your frontend for free. Cloudflare Workers handles your backend logic for free. Supabase stores your orders for free. NOWPayments verifies [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-honest-side-side|Crypto Payments]]-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you|crypto]] payments for 0.5%. No subscriptions. No platform risk. No middlemen. This is sovereign commerce infrastructure. Built for creators in Zimbabwe and beyond who need to sell digital products without begging permission. Deploy today. Own forever.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms fail because they control the stack. They decide who sells, what sells, and when you get paid. Sovereign infrastructure removes the middleman. Cloudflare Pages serves your store globally with no hosting fees. Cloudflare Workers processes orders without servers. Supabase stores your data without databases to manage. NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain—no buyer account required. This stack is permissionless. It runs on open protocols. You deploy it once, and it’s yours. No platform can shut it down. No currency collapse can block it. No payment processor can reject you. This is infrastructure for creators who choose ownership over renting. It’s built to withstand the exact conditions that locked you out of Stripe and PayPal. Deploy it, and your store operates on the same network layer as Cloudflare—globally distributed, always online, and fully yours.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, gather your assets. You need your digital products—ebooks, courses, templates—uploaded to Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. You need a NOWPayments account configured for your preferred cryptocurrency (BSC, Solana, or TRON recommended for low fees). You need a Cloudflare account to access Pages and Workers. You need a domain—or use a free Cloudflare Pages subdomain. You do not need technical expertise. The Edge Commerce Stack handles deployment for you. But you must provide the assets and payment configuration. This is not a SaaS platform. It’s infrastructure. You own it. You control it. Prepare your products, configure your payment layer, and deploy. The stack handles the rest.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Your payment pipeline verifies transactions on-chain. Your delivery pipeline sends products instantly after payment confirms. NOWPayments handles verification. Cloudflare Workers triggers delivery. Here’s how: Integrate NOWPayments with your store. Set the webhook to fire when payment confirms. Cloudflare Workers listens for the webhook. When it fires, Workers generates a secure download link for your product. The link expires after one use. The customer pays, the webhook triggers, the product delivers. No manual intervention. No platform fees. No buyer account required. Test this pipeline on mainnet before going live. Send a test payment. Ensure the product delivers. Once confirmed, your store is ready to process real transactions.
Cloudflare Pages hosts your store globally for free—no hosting fees, ever.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to Cloudflare Pages. Point your domain. Promote your product. When the first transaction hits, NOWPayments verifies the payment on-chain. Cloudflare Workers sends the product. Supabase logs the order. You get paid directly to your wallet. No platform touches your funds. No intermediary delays your payout. The infrastructure handles [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-cloudflare-r2-digital-4|COREMERCH guide to everything]] automatically. Monitor your dashboard. Track transactions in Supabase. Watch your wallet for payments. This is sovereign commerce. You own the stack. You control the flow. Your customers get their products instantly. Your store runs 24/7 on Cloudflare’s global network. No downtime. No platform risk. Just infrastructure that works.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Your store is live. Now scale it. Add more products to Cloudflare R2. Configure additional payment currencies in NOWPayments. Optimize your Cloudflare Workers logic for higher volume. The Edge Commerce Stack includes a scaling playbook. Follow it to expand your catalog, reach more customers, and process more transactions. This infrastructure is built to grow. It’s not a workaround. It’s base-layer architecture. Cloudflare handles the traffic. Supabase handles the data. NOWPayments handles the payments. You focus on creating and selling. No platform limits your growth. No payment processor blocks your country. Your store runs on infrastructure you own. Scale it as far as your ambition takes you.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Deploying a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free works by leveraging serverless infrastructure and on-chain payment verification. Cloudflare Pages hosts your frontend. Cloudflare Workers handles backend logic. Supabase stores order data. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments. No hosting fees. No server management. No platform risk. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys this infrastructure for you in 48 hours. You own it after deployment. No subscriptions. No middlemen. Just sovereign commerce infrastructure that runs globally on Cloudflare’s network.
NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain with a 0.5% fee—no buyer account required.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Ready to deploy? The Edge Commerce Stack handles everything for you. We deploy your store on Cloudflare Pages, configure Cloudflare Workers, set up Supabase, and integrate NOWPayments. Your stack goes live in 48 hours. You own it forever. No platform risk. No payment rejections. Sovereign commerce infrastructure built for creators who need to sell without permission. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Gather your digital products and upload them to Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. 2. Create a NOWPayments account and configure your preferred cryptocurrency. 3. Set up a Cloudflare account to access Pages and Workers. 4. Prepare your domain or use a free Cloudflare Pages subdomain. 5. Deploy the Edge Commerce Stack or follow the Sovereign Blueprint for manual deployment. 6. Test your payment and delivery pipeline on mainnet. 7. Deploy your store to Cloudflare Pages and point your domain. 8. Promote your products and start processing transactions. 9. Monitor your dashboard and wallet for payments. 10. Follow the scaling playbook to expand your catalog and reach.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys the infrastructure for you. You provide your products and payment configuration. No coding required.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. We recommend BSC, Solana, or TRON for low transaction fees under $0.10.
Do I need a domain to deploy my store?
No. You can use a free Cloudflare Pages subdomain. If you have a domain, point it to your deployed store.
How are products delivered to customers?
Cloudflare Workers generates a secure, single-use download link after payment confirms. The link is sent automatically to the customer.
What happens if a payment fails?
NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain. If a payment fails, no webhook fires, and no product is delivered. The customer must retry with a valid transaction.
You own the infrastructure after deployment—no platform risk, no subscriptions.
